title: Excel gene-name coercion
scope: Selected genomics journals; papers with supplementary Excel gene lists
lesson: Silent coercion can corrupt semantics without producing a file error.
caution: This is not an error rate for all spreadsheets or all scientific fields; the statistic comes from a specific study context.

title: Research-data attrition with age
scope: Odds that a dataset was reported as extant across 516 studies aged 2–22 years
lesson: Relying on a researcher's computer or memory for long-term preservation is fragile.
caution: The result applies to the study sample and must not be generalized into a universal annual attrition rate across domains.

title: Reference rot
scope: STM articles across large corpora; seven in ten among articles containing web references
lesson: A URL alone is not a sustainability strategy for scientific context.
caution: The statistic concerns web references, not specifically repository objects resolved through DOIs.
